In his role as non-executive Chairman, Peter Starrett will receive the same compensation and benefits as the other non-employee directors serving on the Board.

The filing refers to a prior 8-K filed on May 5, 2025 and an amendment filed on May 14, 2025, which described the appointment of John Hazen as Chief Executive Officer and the temporary Executive Chairman role for Peter Starrett.

# Boot Barn appoints John Hazen as CEO

People

Boot Barn store Credits: Facebook/Boot Barn

By Prachi Singh

loading...

Apparel and footwear retailer Boot Barn has officially appointed John Hazen as its chief executive officer, effective May 5, 2025. Hazen had been serving as the company's interim CEO since November 2024.

Peter Starrett, executive chairman of Boot Barn, expressed confidence in Hazen's leadership, stating, "After a comprehensive search process, the board unanimously concluded that John is the right leader to drive Boot Barn forward. We believe that his deep industry knowledge, proven track record in digital transformation, and clear vision for the future make him exceptionally qualified for this role.” [...] Hazen brings over two decades of experience in the apparel and footwear industry. He joined Boot Barn in 2018 as chief digital officer. Prior to that, he held senior positions at Ring, True Religion, Kellwood, Nike, and Fox Racing.

In his statement, Hazen said, "I am honored and excited to lead Boot Barn as we continue to build on our strong foundation and focus on consistent, long-term growth."

As of May 2025, Boot Barn operates 464 stores across 49 states and maintains an e-commerce presence through its websites, including BootBarn.com, Sheplers.com, and CountryOutfitter.com.
